_comment: Summary writers in order (T12.63b, docs/summary-order.md sections 2, 4.4, 4.5, 5 and 10). steps: each step's label on the Summaries page and the re-summarise menu ({device} a computer's name from its presence, {writer} its writer kind from offload_copy_cases.json writers, {host} the endpoint's host). destinations: the line under each step saying where the transcript goes. writers: the same steps as the subject of a banner sentence. words: the fixed outcome word of each step that was left for the next one, by the runtime's OutcomeWord. step_outcome joins a writer and its word, joiner joins those. later_writer: banner summary-steps when a later step wrote the summary; no_summary: the same banner when every step failed. start_check / start_check_last: the meeting-start banner of a step known to fail now, with and without a later step. interrupted: a run that did not end (a restart, or a record that cannot be read). named_hand_back: a computer named by a re-summarise that handed the request back. continue_note: the first warning of the re-summary that goes on with the next step after a computer handed it back. not_now: a local step skipped while a newer meeting needed this computer. page: the Summaries page section (T12.68: one list of writers, each ticked writer with its rank; list its accessible name, use, move_up and move_down a writer's controls ({writer} its label), too_many a fourth tick ({n} the most steps), not_set_up an endpoint and not_downloaded the local model that cannot be ticked yet, kept_local the line under the list). resummarise: the meeting header's split button and its job notices' titles. refusals: a refused order, as the page shows the runtime's refusal. unnamed: a computer whose name is not known, at the start of a sentence. Pinned to the desktop's copy by its tests and read by the UI and its mock. Shipped with the app: public copy only. T14.66 (docs/summary-order.md 11.9, approved by the owner 2026-11-28): earlier lists the steps already left under the waiting banner ({steps}); moving is the run note while a run goes on after a step was left ({steps}, {next}); stopped_note is the run note after Stop ({device}); stop holds the waiting banner's Stop button (button, label with {device}, already_written with {device} when that computer wrote it, already_summarised when a summary arrived from a computer not known, not_waiting, failed); in_progress the header line while a new summary is written (here, or on with {device}); list_elsewhere the meeting list's word for a summary written on another computer; local_failures the sentence for each kind of local summary failure, by the runtime's LocalFailureKind word. finishing_tip: a header button's tooltip while the meeting finishes ({label} the button's name).

destinations.endpoint_unset: Goes to the address you enter
destinations.claude_code: Goes to Anthropic through Claude Code
destinations.computer: Goes to {device}, which writes it with its {writer}

interrupted: The summary was interrupted. Summarise it again to write it.
continue_note: {device} could not write the summary, so the next writer in your order writes it instead.
not_now: The summary model was not run while a newer meeting needed this computer. Summarise this meeting again to write it.

page.too_many: At most {n} writers can be ticked. Untick one first.
page.explained: Earshot asks the ticked writers in order. If one can't write the summary, the next one tries. Untick a writer to leave it out.
page.kept_local: Meetings you keep on this computer skip your own server, Claude Code and Codex, and use the model on this computer when no other computer of yours writes the summary.
page.reading: Reading the order of summary writers
page.not_read: The order of summary writers could not be read

resummarise.kept_local: This meeting is kept on this computer

refusals.too_many_steps: An order holds at most 3 steps.
refusals.twice: A writer can appear only once in the order.
refusals.this_device: This computer cannot be one of its own steps.

stopped_note: You stopped this summary and asked {device} to stop writing it. Re-summarise to write it again.

stop.label: Stop the summary on {device}
stop.already_summarised: A summary of this meeting had already arrived.
stop.not_waiting: This summary is no longer waiting for another computer.
stop.failed: The summary could not be stopped. Try again.

local_failures.too_long: The meeting is too long for the summary model on this computer. Choose another writer in Settings, Summaries.
local_failures.reply_unusable: The summary model on this computer wrote a reply Earshot could not use, even after asking it to correct it. Try again or choose another model.
local_failures.card_stopped: The graphics card's summary process stopped before it finished. Try again: the next summary tries the card again.
local_failures.stalled: The summary model on this computer stopped making progress. Restart Earshot and try again.
local_failures.load_failed: The summary model on this computer could not be loaded. Try again, or choose another model in Settings, Summaries.
local_failures.load_stuck: An earlier summary model load is stuck. Restart Earshot and try again.
local_failures.wrong_backend: The summary model did not load where Earshot asked it to. Try again.
local_failures.cuda_changed: The CUDA files changed after Earshot started. Restart Earshot so it can check them.

finishing_tip: {label}: available when the summary is done.
